## Change

Describe the input or use case, and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the tests and commands you ran. For performance changes, include the
runtime, corpus size, before/after timings, and output-equivalence check.

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or I explained why no test is needed.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] Fixtures and outputs contain only synthetic or fully anonymized data.
- [ ] Published behavior changes have a changeset and updated examples/types.
- [ ] No private corpus files, generated output, or secrets are included.
